## Illustrative Example 1

Visual example of two-dimensional kNN classification

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(class)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(4050)

# Load data
data(iris)

df <- iris %>%
  select(Petal.Length, Petal.Width, Species)

# Train/Test Split
train_index <- sample(1:nrow(df), 0.7*nrow(df))
train <- df[train_index, ]
test  <- df[-train_index, ]

# KNN prediction
k <- 5
pred <- knn(
  train = train[,1:2],
  test  = test[,1:2],
  cl    = train$Species,
  k = k
)

test$Predicted <- pred

# Accuracy
accuracy <- mean(test$Predicted == test$Species)

# Decision boundary grid
x_range <- seq(min(df$Petal.Length)-0.5,
               max(df$Petal.Length)+0.5,
               length = 200)

y_range <- seq(min(df$Petal.Width)-0.5,
               max(df$Petal.Width)+0.5,
               length = 200)

grid <- expand.grid(
  Petal.Length = x_range,
  Petal.Width  = y_range
)

grid$Species <- knn(
  train = train[,1:2],
  test  = grid,
  cl    = train$Species,
  k = k
)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = grid,
            aes(Petal.Length, Petal.Width, fill = Species),
            alpha = 0.30) +
  geom_point(data = train,
             aes(Petal.Length, Petal.Width, color = Species),
             size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = test,
             aes(Petal.Length, Petal.Width, color = Predicted),
             shape = 4,
             size = 4,
             stroke = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = paste("KNN Classification (k =", k, ")"),
    subtitle = paste("Test Accuracy =", round(accuracy,3)),
    x = "Petal Length",
    y = "Petal Width",
    color = "Class",
    fill = "Decision Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Example 1 from slides

```{r}
library(caret)
library(rsample)

Penguins <- read.csv("Penguins3.csv")

set.seed(4050)

P2 <- Penguins %>%
  dplyr::select(c(2:5)) %>%
  scale() %>%
  cbind(Penguins[,1,drop=FALSE])

P_split <- initial_split(P2, prop = 0.75) 

# Extract the training and testing data frames
train_data <- training(P_split)
test_data <- testing(P_split)


# k = 2 

pred0 <- knn(
  train = train_data[,1:4],
  test  = test_data[,1:4],
  cl    = train_data$species,
  k = 2
)

confusionMatrix(pred0,factor(test_data$species))


# k = 3





```

## Illustrative Example 2

```{r}


cv <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv", 
  number = 10, 
  repeats = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE
)

# Create a hyperparameter grid search
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  k = floor(seq(1, nrow(train)/3, length.out = 30))
)

# Fit knn model and perform grid search
knn_grid <- train(
  Species~., 
  data = train, 
  method = "knn", 
  trControl = cv, 
  tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

knn_grid
ggplot(knn_grid)


## Testing ##

predIE2 <- knn(train = train[,1:2],
  test  = test[,1:2],
  cl    = train$Species,
  k = 6
  
)

confusionMatrix(predIE2,test$Species)

```

## Illustrative Example 3

```{r}

library(caret)

set.seed(123)

# Load data
data(iris)

# Train/Test split
train_index <- createDataPartition(iris$Petal.Length, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train <- iris[train_index, ]
test  <- iris[-train_index, ]

# Cross-validation setup
cv <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 10,
  repeats = 5
)

# Hyperparameter grid
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  k = seq(1, 25, by = 2)
)

# Train kNN regression model
knn_model <- train(
  Petal.Length ~ .,
  data = train,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = cv,
  tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  metric = "RMSE",
  preProcess = c("center","scale")
)

knn_model
plot(knn_model)

# Does it work?

pred <- predict(knn_model, newdata = test)
RMSE(pred, test$Petal.Length)
R2(pred, test$Petal.Length)

plot(test$Petal.Length, pred,
     xlab = "Observed Petal Length",
     ylab = "Predicted Petal Length",
     main = "kNN Regression: Iris Dataset")
abline(0,1,col="red",lwd=2)

```

## Illustrative Example 4

```{r}


library(kknn)
library(caret)

set.seed(4050)

# Load data
data(iris)

# Train/test split
train_index <- createDataPartition(iris$Petal.Length, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train <- iris[train_index, ]
test  <- iris[-train_index, ]

# Cross-validation
cv <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 10,
  repeats = 5
)

# Hyperparameter grid
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  kmax = seq(3, 25, 2),      # number of neighbors
  distance = c(1,2),         # 1 = Manhattan, 2 = Euclidean
  kernel = "rectangular"     # uniform weighting
)

# Train model
kknn_model <- train(
  Petal.Length ~ Sepal.Length + Sepal.Width + Petal.Width + Species,
  data = train,
  method = "kknn",
  trControl = cv,
  tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  metric = "RMSE",
  preProcess = c("center","scale")
)

kknn_model
```
